source_text:
# API Gateway Configuration

Here are the supported timeout settings:

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `connect_timeout` | Duration | `5s` | Connection establishment deadline |
| `read_timeout` | Duration | `30s` | Body transfer idle deadline |

## Checklist
- [x] Check network firewall
- [ ] Update DNS records

```json
{
  "port": 8080,
  "tls_enabled": true
}
```
